title: KotlinForForge issue #67: Crashes minecraft

text:
[issue by AstroJoot]
Whenever I launch Minecraft with it in my mod list it crashes and I have no clue why, exit code is: 1

[comment by thedarkcolour (owner)]
Visit the Discord server of whatever mod you are using that requires KFF (Cobblemon? Better Foliage? InvProfiles Next?)

[comment by AstroJoot (none)]
But it's only KFF because I went through all my mods and it only stopped crashing when i disabled KFF

[comment by thedarkcolour (owner)]
I assure you it's not (it has never been in dozens of reports), it's whatever mod you're using that depends on KFF
